name: Esri ArcGIS
description: Synchronizes features with Esri ArcGIS: ingests ArcGIS Feature and Map Server layers to the map on a schedule and optionally pushes map features back out to ArcGIS.

permissions.description: Posts ingested ArcGIS features to the map and reads map features to push out to ArcGIS

schedule.description: Polls the configured ArcGIS layer for updated features on a schedule.

types.description: Accepts map features to write out to the configured ArcGIS Feature Services
